results: overdue recurring items stay in Coming up, turn red, say LATE and keep a Post button; future ones are not late
a hand-entered register transaction with the same amount and account is offered as a match; unrelated items are not
Posted links the register entry, removes the item and changes no balance
Skip removes the item, lists it under Skipped, and a second device sees the linked and skipped state
Restore returns a skipped item to Coming up, still marked late
Post from a late row creates the transaction, updates the balance and removes the item
deleting the linked register entry reopens the item in Coming up
Coming up has no horizontal overflow at phone, tablet and desktop widths
